title: Move Business Skills core into System Application
summary: Business Skills core functionality moves from NAV BusinessIQ into System Application, adding authoring APIs, builder, pages, content history, and XML import/export capabilities with comprehensive test coverage.
key_points: Business Skills AL core components migrate to System Application in BC30
Includes authoring and lifecycle APIs, app-owned builder, and content management UI pages
Adds content versioning history, XML import/export, and test infrastructure
Discovery, search, HTTP APIs, and Agent API remain in NAV BusinessIQ
New independent Business Skills Test Library packaged separately for testing
quote: Move the Business Skills AL core into System Application, consuming the platform's Business Skill system table.
